summary: Kept by esv::hit::RedirectionSystem (Toolkit users ProcessTrackingRequests, FinalizeTrackingRequests, ProcessEntityDestruction, ProcessExecutionRequests): an Array of 32-byte tracking records per entity, rebuilt by bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 (removes the component when the list is empty, otherwise clears the array and copies the new records). Records hold two entity handles (the second resolved through esv::status::OwnershipComponent when a type byte is 3) and several flag bytes. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840: local record starts with local_d8 = 0xffc0000000000000 (null handle) at +0. Line 241 stores local_d8 = the entity of the request (local_e8 = *puVar13, line 149).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: local uStack_d0 (+8): an entity handle, replaced by the owner from esv::status::OwnershipComponent when the source type byte equals 3, then checked alive. Lines 199-214: checked to be a live entity handle (generation compare in the entity table).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 lines 231-234: the byte at +4 of the source record is stored here when it is neither 0 nor 0x0E; the record dword +0x10 is packed as CONCAT13(c5, c6, c7, c8), i.e. four separate bytes.

fields.name: field_11
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840: zeroed (line 173), set to 1 together with field_10 (line 233) - the has-value flag of field_10.

fields.name: field_12
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 lines 236-239: the byte at +5 of the source record when neither 0 nor 0x0E.

fields.name: field_13
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840: zeroed (line 174), set to 1 together with field_12 - the has-value flag of field_12.

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 line 242: `uStack_c4 = *puVar27` - the first 4 bytes of the source record; stored as the record dword +0x14.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 line 207: low byte of the dword +0x18 = byte +6 of the source record, which the same function tests `!= 0` to decide whether the record is kept (line 229).

fields.name: _Pad19
fields.evidence: Never written: the three upper bytes of the dword +0x18 keep their cleared value (line 176 `& 0xffffff00`) and the dword +0x1C (uStack_bc) is never assigned; record stride 0x20.

fields.name: Records
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EE6530 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes +0, +8, +0xC (Array pattern); destructor thunk of bg3.exe+0x5946C0 frees the buffer (trivial elements). bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 lines 326-367 set size +0xC to 0, grow with FUN_1406da440 and copy 32-byte records `(size * 0x20 + *array)`.

open_questions: Meanings: two entity handles, two optional bytes (value + has flag, value 0 and 0x0E ignored - possibly an enum where 0x0E is 'none'), a 4-byte value and a bool. No names on the Windows side.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
